paper.title: Preference-Oriented Evolutionary Multi-Objective Energy-Noise Optimization for Fast Wind Farm Layout Design
paper.authors: Ya-Zhi Zhang and Sheng Huang and Juan Wei and Bing-Chuan Wang and Yun Feng and Yaonan Wang

public_asset_candidate_evidence.status: target final article found; exact-title DOI method author GitHub-code and institutional searches found no target code, measured arrays, seeds or result archive

paper_source_conflicts: The nomenclature defines K as Weibull shape and C as scale, while Fig.5 labels K=8.3 and C=2.0; the plotted density peaking near 6m/s is consistent only with scale8.3 and shape2.0, so the figure-consistent interpretation controls.
Algorithm 1 advances n by NP, while the runtime explanation states infeasible trial vectors are not evaluated; nominal evaluation slots and physical FES are therefore reported separately.

exact octave source spectrum, atmospheric absorption, ground and terrain settings

completion_decisions: Retain all six unique combinations of three farm sizes and original/adjusted preference stages, with ten formal seeds per role.
Use the figure-consistent Weibull scale8.3 shape2.0 and a normalized deterministic sixteen-sector digitization.
Use Table-II turbine/power constants, Table-III site/original reference points and Table-VI adjusted reference points literally.
Use a declared hard-ground ISO engineering specialization with printed 105dB per-band wording and standard octave attenuation coefficients.
Complete CR as0.9, LP as50, SFM as Laplace-smoothed rolling success/failure counts and scale clipping as [0.05,1.5].
Separate paper nominal evaluation slots from actual complete feasible-layout physical FES.
Use one persistent full-core team for frozen-generation offspring construction, feasible-trial evaluation and dominance rows with ordered commits.
